answers.core: Since Godot allows you to set the freelook speed to 1000.0 units per second without any add-ons, I think the engine should also allow it as a default setting.
answers.workaround: I've tried overriding the setting manually by opening **editor_settings-4.4.tres** in a text editor, changing the value to 1000.0, and restarting Godot. But everytime Godot launches it resets the value back to 10.0.

title: Freelook Base Speed in 3D editor settings should allow higher values
